source: Seeker LibraryRoster.json + GamePresentation.json + hash-checked registry artifacts

games.title: Adjustris
games.author: Dave VanEe
games.description: Stack falling blocks, clear complete rows, and chase a new high score. A compact, quick-to-learn puzzle game for short handheld sessions.
games.controls: D-pad moves pieces; A/B rotate. Start pauses.

games.title: Black Castle
games.author: User0x7f
games.description: Fight through a haunted castle to challenge the warlock threatening your kingdom. Explore hidden passages, collect items, and time every jump.
games.controls: D-pad moves; A jumps; B attacks; Start pauses.

games.title: Bomberman (Homebrew)
games.author: T.M
games.description: Place bombs in a maze, escape the blast, and clear the enemies in your path. A homebrew take on the classic arena-bombing formula.
games.controls: D-pad moves; A or B places a bomb; Start pauses.

games.title: Dawn Will Come
games.author: eishiya, H0lyhandgrenade and C_DOS_KEZ
games.description: Lead a small camp through an endless night. Assign survivors to rest, guard, or search, manage scarce supplies, and face the creatures outside.
games.controls: D-pad navigates; A confirms. Assign tasks at the campfire.

games.title: Flappy Bird Gameboy
games.author: Larolds Jubilant Junkyard
games.description: Keep the bird airborne with carefully timed taps and thread the gaps between pipes. One mistake ends the run; one more try might beat your best.
games.controls: Tap A to flap; use Start to begin.

games.title: Libbet and the Magic Floor
games.author: Damian Yerrick (pinobatch)
games.description: Help Libbet change the magic floor, one tile at a time. Plan your route across compact puzzle boards and work out how each move changes the pattern.
games.controls: D-pad moves; follow the in-game introduction for tile rules.

games.title: Quartet
games.author: Mackerel Interactive
games.description: Build faces from four matching sections before time runs out. Send the center piece into one of four windows and keep the board clear for longer runs.
games.controls: D-pad places pieces; Start pauses.

games.title: Rayslinger
games.author: Unicore
games.description: Run, jump, and blast through a colorful science-fiction platformer prototype. Experiment with gravity and speed chips to change how you cross each area.
games.controls: D-pad moves; B jumps; A fires; Down/Up activate gravity/speed chips.

games.title: Rhythm Land
games.author: martendo and eat_butt_loser_butt
games.description: Skate, flip pancakes, sing, and battle to the beat in a collection of rhythmic mini-games. Listen for the cue, then hit the right button on time.
games.controls: A or D-pad follows each game’s beat; Start pauses.

games.title: Scorching Light
games.author: Pasquale “Pasqui industry” Pignataro
games.description: In this eerie puzzle platformer, light is lethal. Blend into the scenery, study enemy movements, and find a safe route through a hostile world.
games.controls: D-pad moves/climbs; A jumps; Select outlines your character; Start pauses.

games.title: SUPER IMPOSTOR BROS.
games.author: LumpyTouch, Danee and MelonadeM
games.description: A spacefaring fan game mixing platforming and visual-novel choices. Find hidden ID cards across three stages to unlock items and change your story options.
games.controls: D-pad moves; A jumps; B attacks; Start pauses.

games.title: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe
games.author: Tangram Games
games.description: Your cat is floating away. Bounce off enemies, dash in eight directions, and flap for height as you race upward through bright, compact arcade stages.
games.controls: D-pad directs movement and dashes; bounce on enemies to climb.

games.title: Unearthed Zero
games.author: BenJelter and Gumpy Function
games.description: Pilot a company-issued mining mech across alien worlds. Dig through compact logic puzzles, plan every move, and uncover the story beneath the surface.
games.controls: D-pad moves; A interacts; B digs; Select exits the mech; Start pauses.

games.title: 2048 Advance
games.author: Basil Termini
games.description: Slide a board of numbered tiles, combine equal values, and build toward 2048. Every move reshapes the puzzle, so keep space open and plan ahead.
games.controls: D-pad slides tiles; follow Start/Select prompts for saving and a new game.

games.title: Anguna: Warriors of Virtue
games.author: Nathan Tolbert; artwork by Chris Hildenbrand
games.description: Escape a monster-infested dungeon, explore a connected overworld, and uncover five labyrinths full of hidden rooms, tools, and bosses. A compact top-down fantasy adventure.
games.controls: D-pad moves; follow the in-game controls for weapons, items, and menus.

games.title: Apotris
games.author: akouzoukos
games.description: Stack pieces, clear lines, and tune the handling to your style. A fast, customizable GBA puzzle game with responsive controls and multiple modes for chasing a personal best.
games.controls: Use D-pad and A/B; adjust handling and button mappings in the game settings.

games.title: Blind Jump
games.author: Evan Bowman
games.description: Fight through procedurally generated alien outposts, collect equipment, and reach the next teleporter. Strafe past robots, manage your loadout, and survive periodic bosses.
games.controls: D-pad moves; B fires/strafe; A interacts/dodges; L opens the map; R selects items; Select opens inventory.

games.title: Goodboy Galaxy
games.author: Goodboy Galaxy Ltd. (Rik Nicol and Jeremy Clarke)
games.description: Stranded in a hostile star system, Maxwell must make friends, recover lost abilities, and find a way home. Explore colorful alien worlds in a GBA platform adventure.
games.controls: D-pad moves; follow the in-game tutorials for jumping, tools, and the map.

games.title: Green Memories
games.author: Tengukaze Studio
games.description: Guide scientist Cytra through a ruined, climate-scarred landscape. Explore, gather resources, and fight hostile creatures while uncovering the fate of a vanished expedition.
games.controls: D-pad moves; follow the in-game prompts for interacting, combat, and inventory.

games.title: Snek GBA
games.author: LeonarthCG; title/victory art: CeciDibujera
games.description: Guide Snek toward every egg without hitting a wall or your own tail. Choose a speed, grow four segments per egg, and aim to fill the entire board.
games.controls: D-pad steers and selects speed; Start begins or pauses.

games.title: Spindown
games.author: Chris Pickel (sfiera)
games.description: Turn the whole board and let gravity do the work. Guide colored marbles into their goals, reposition obstacles, and undo moves while you find a solution.
games.controls: L/R rotate the board; B undoes; A redoes; Select restarts; Start pauses.

games.title: Color Lines
games.author: cosmigo (pan|cgo, dsc|cgo, bfa|cgo)
games.description: Move colorful pieces into lines of five or more to clear the board. Keep paths open: every move competes with the next pieces waiting to arrive.
games.controls: D-pad moves the cursor; A/B selects or deselects; Start pauses.

games.title: Grand Battle Stadium
games.author: Elvies and collaborators
games.description: A crossover arena for characters from the GB Studio community. Jump into platform-fighting action, discover different fighters, and explore its arcade battles.
games.controls: D-pad moves; A jumps; B attacks; Start pauses. Other abilities depend on mode.

games.title: Saint Seiya: The Phoenix Returns
games.author: Zeichis GamePlay Short; English translation: El Ramses
games.description: A fan-made Saint Seiya adventure retelling the Black Saints arc. Fight through story-led stages, switch heroes, and look for hidden collectibles.
games.controls: D-pad moves; A jumps; B attacks; Up+B uses a special; Start pauses.

games.title: uCity
games.author: AntonioND (SkyLyrac)
games.description: Build a city on a tiny screen. Lay out roads, grow residential and industrial districts, and balance the services and budget that keep your citizens happy.
games.controls: D-pad moves the cursor; follow the in-game menus for construction tools.

games.title: Lunar Limit
games.author: Pubby; code: Damian Yerrick; music: MovieMovies1
games.description: Survive waves of enemies in a single-screen starfield. Your ship fires automatically; steer to safety, rotate your gun, and spend power-ups at the right moment.
games.controls: D-pad flies; A/B turns the gun; Select uses a power-up; Start begins.

games.title: Helheim
games.author: asbiz
games.description: A Norse action RPG for the SNES. Explore a dark isometric world, choose a hero, battle restless creatures, and follow a saga of ruined villages and ancient barrows.
games.controls: D-pad walks; B strikes; A uses a skill; X interacts; Y heals; Start opens panels.
